mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently higher interest rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances where HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a slowdown in economic activity, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals accommodative monetary policy in a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS and UNRATE both decrease.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently higher interest rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real final sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP (GDPC1) combined with a decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals economic growth without corresponding production, leading to supply chain issues and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: economic growth with supply chain issues
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances where GDPC1 increases and INDPRO decreases.
